content: serde_yaml is archived/unmaintained (latest release tagged 0.9.34+deprecated). serde_yml, a popular fork alternative, is ITSELF now flagged unsound/unmaintained per RustSec advisory RUSTSEC-2025-0068 (confirmed via official rustsec.org advisory + rustsec/advisory-db#2132 tracking issue) — do not migrate to serde_yml. serde_norway is the currently-maintained fork (uses unsafe-libyaml-norway); other alternatives noyalib, serde-saphyr, yaml-rust2 exist for narrower use cases. Verified locally: agent-install/omni-agent-rs/src/config.rs already migrated its 2 call sites (from_str/to_string) to serde_norway 0.9.42; cargo check passes clean.
